title: Even with 49ers and Rams not in play, there are plenty of good options for Seahawks' opening game

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Even with 49ers and Rams not in play, there are plenty of good options for Seahawks' opening game
sources.description: The Seahawks, if the NFL concocts its schedule in the usual way, will open the 2026 season with a home game on Thursday, September 10.
